text_block_list.text:
Three milestone years for Rhein Kraft and 
myself. The same holds true for the other 
Umamusume as well.

Having run through the Senior Class, the 
Umamusume were now stepping onto their own 
respective paths.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Are you really going?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. I've submitted my leave of absence 
to the academy, and I'd like to study 
"training" over there.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Because passing on what I've learned... 
was always my dream.

"Apparently, Cesario will be spending the 
next few months with a regional team to 
learn the ropes of being an educator."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...But once I'm done studying, I promise 
I'll come right back.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Can you wake up by yourself until then? 
You won't be a sleepyhead, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. You don't need to worry that 
much, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

With tears welling in her eyes, Rhein 
Kraft embraced her best friend.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Good luck, Cesario. No matter where you 
go, I'll be cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I have received your cheer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ..."See you later", Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, see you later.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Then I shall take my leave here as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
! Oh right, Messiah-san is going back home 
for a while too, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was thinking of taking some proper 
time off for once to spend a relaxing time 
with Mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Until we meet again, Miss Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. See you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ah~... Is it my turn next then?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san! ...Are you going back to 
America too, Heart-san?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Right—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Why would I go home? I'm here to see them 
off, just like you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm still a challenger, after all. Right? 
...Queen?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...And on top of that!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —I met a girl like you, too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I will team up with her and 
continue my training. ...So that I may 
surpass you."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to get pretty strong. Are you 
ready?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. These three years went by in the 
blink of an eye, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Did you know, Trainer? The horse girls on 
this year's Tiara route are supposed to be 
crazy strong, everyone's talking about it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
One of them is aiming for the Triple 
Tiara. The other is aiming for the 
Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah. And also! Apparently there are 
Umamusume who specialize in sprint races 
too!

Thinking of the new future beginning to 
sprout, Rhein Kraft's expression softens 
with a smile.
choice_data_list:
I wonder if a girl like you will be born 
from that

I wonder if a girl like you will be born 
from that

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ummm... well.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? If you have a dream you 
want to prioritize over the "Irregular 
Triple Crown," I'd really love for you to 
go after that instead.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If the path I ran and lived... gives those 
girls a push forward, even by just a 
single millimeter.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—I might actually end up thinking of that 
as a really happy thing.

...The Queen's smile as she said that was 
more beautiful than any queen I had ever 
known.

I wanted to offer a blessing worthy of her 
and the journey she has walked to get 
here, with my own hands.
choice_data_list:
Craft, there's a place I want to go with 
you.

Craft, there's a place I want to go with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“......Wait, isn't this... where we came 
after the NHK Mile Cup—?”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer. This... this tiara is—

Unlike the typical image of a tiara, this 
one wasn't made of silverware, nor did it 
have any jewels.

It wouldn't have enough weight to properly 
honor the glory she achieved.

Even so, with all the gratitude in my 
heart, I shall present her with a special 
tiara meant just for her.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Please don't forget, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That I was here. And the things I was able 
to leave behind here.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That there was a Rhein Kraft who kept 
running together with you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...I won't forget either.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

Petals flutter. The wind blows. Along with 
the spring breeze, new seeds begin to 
sprout.

Within that unbroken continuum, a Queen 
named Rhein Kraft undeniably existed.
